description: List evidence items tracked against an organization's controls. Returns each item's tracking status, maturity level, and linked controls. Optionally filter by system.

accountable_owner_type.description: Filter by the accountable team's primary owner: 'internal' or 'external_contractor'

function_id.description: Filter to evidence assigned to any team aligned to this function — obtain from scf_list_functions

my_teams.description: Filter to evidence assigned to any team the caller belongs to; intersects with team_id rather than overriding it. 'The caller' is the API key's identity; on a self-hosted instance that is a service account on no team, so this returns nothing — use team_id instead.

system_id.description: System UUID to filter by — obtain from scf_list_systems

team_id.description: Filter to evidence this team is assigned to, accountable or consulted — obtain from scf_list_teams

name: scf_list_evidence
